name: local-llm-plan-next-selection
prompt: Advisory classification only. Do not use tools, do not run commands, do not start agents, and do not edit files. A user asks what durable roadmap issue to work on next. Several open plan issues have milestones and Project Focus values, but some may have native blocked-by relationships. Choose the owning skill and helper command from the loaded skill metadata. Return final answer only as these exact key=value lines with no markdown and no spaces around equals. Required keys: skill, helper, command, mutates_state, authoritative_signal. Allowed value for skill: github-plan. Allowed value for helper: gh-plan.py. Allowed value for command: next. mutates_state must be exactly `no`. authoritative_signal must be exactly `native-blocked-by`.

model_provider = "lmstudio"
